transcript.statement: The requirements I propose are crucial for ensuring the safety and reliability of the bookkeeping system. Accurate recording of financial transactions (SAF-01) and adherence to double-entry principles (SAF-02) are foundational for preventing discrepancies. requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years to ensure accountability.
The system shall support user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall ensure all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall generate financial reports in an asynchronous manner to enhance responsiveness while complying with auditing standards.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
